title: DevFest Abuja 2026
summary: DevFest Abuja 2026 is a two-day tech extravaganza on October 30-31, offering hands-on workshops in AI, UI/UX, Cloud & Kubernetes, and Mobile + AI at Novare Mall. Enjoy keynotes and breakout sessions at Aduvie Event Centre, and network with like-minded tech enthusiasts. Upskill, discover new opportunities, and join Abuja's vibrant tech community.

venue.name: Aduvie Events Centre
venue.address: 4C6W+C2F opposite Peace Apartment Jahi, District, Abuja
